name.value: Strike Zone Bowling and Mini Golf

description.value: Strike Zone is a long-running Prince George institution founded in 1994, offering 16 lanes of 10-pin bowling alongside an 18-hole themed indoor glow-in-the-dark mini golf course and an arcade — all under one roof with no reservations required. It is one of the few combined bowling-and-mini-golf venues in BC's central interior, making it a distinctive stop for touring cyclists seeking an off-bike activity in Prince George.
